invariants.rationale: The method accesses tileSet and its properties, so it cannot be null.
imageResolver.getImage(...) is called in both branches, so it must not be null.
tmxFile.path() and other FileHandle operations are used, so tmxFile cannot be null.
element is used in child element accesses, so it must not be null.
tileElements is iterated over in the else branch, so it must not be null.
